summary: November 27, 2026: The creator proposes non-transferable literacy badges with facilitator issue and revoke controls and public verification using opaque learner identifiers. The README retains stale not-submitted and not-hosted statements despite the current public submission and page; it also discloses first-come-first-served administrator bootstrap and an unfinished issued-epoch field. Creator-reported engine tests were not rerun. The recording shows the README concept section, not a working on-chain badge service. MIT source and public creator evidence were reviewed. The genuine recording is a source/docs walkthrough with scripts and downloads disabled. No repository code, installed software, wallet or transaction was executed.
cardSummary: Explore issuing, verifying and revoking literacy-achievement badges through a walletless simulation and facilitator-controlled NFT template.
